title: Valerie Ransone arrives at Lab Nine
summary: Unnamed guest tells of Valerie Ransone arrives at Lab Nine, about 1978 at Lab Nine, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: like channel information. And so she somehow wound up at Puharich's lab, lab nine in in '78.

plain: On Jesse Michels's podcast, an unnamed researcher says that a woman named Valerie Ransone, who was said to channel information from other beings, ended up in 1978 at Lab Nine, a research group run by a man named Puharich. The story matters to tellers because Lab Nine is said to have tried to contact a council of non-human beings, and her arrival would place her at the center of that effort.
